title: CustomersCustomerUnblockedPayload
description: Payload of `customers.customer.unblocked` version 1: support unblocked a customer's account with a reason; they can sign in again with nothing else changed. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

customer_id.description: The customer (a user id); fetch personal data from the API when it is needed.
